title: Mobility-Aid Usage Pattern
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eldercare:activity mobility_aid=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as aid_events by _time mobility_aid
| sort 0 _time - aid_events
description: Trends how often each mobility aid is used so changes in support needs are visible over time.
value: Mobility shifts are easier to spot in patterns than in isolated anecdotes, especially across weeks or months.
implementation: Log mobility-aid use in `eldercare:activity`; trend weekly event counts by aid type.
visualization: Line chart of mobility-aid usage by week.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks which mobility supports are being used more or less as needs change.
